title: New in StudyVault: Todo Calendar! 📅
message:
Thanks for updating to v1.3.0! Here's what's new:

✅ Todo Calendar
Plan your study tasks date by date.

📍 How to access:
• Tap any date on calender.

📝 How to use:
• If todos exist for that date, a popup shows them. You can mark them complete or add another one.
• If no todo exists, the popup lets you create one right away.

🎨 What the dots mean:
🟡 Yellow dot: pending todos on that date.
🟢 Green dot: completed todos on that date.

🏠 Home Summary:
Pending todos for today are shown in the summary on your home screen. Completed todos appear only as a green dot on the calendar.

✏️ Also new: you can now rename or delete any subject.

Happy studying! 💙
